title: Composed supervisory control: Off-delay ventilation fan -> Pre-lube motor lifecycle with feedback fault and cooldown

outputs.name: A_RunOn
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Fan is in off-delay run-on

outputs.name: B_Fault
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Latched startup or oil fault

outputs.name: B_State
outputs.description: Subsystem B: 0 idle, 1 pre-lube, 2 feedback proving, 3 running, 4 cooldown

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The runtime scan period is 100 ms.
Subsystem A: A_Demand is held TRUE for at least one scan before an off-delay test.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The runtime scan period is 100 ms.
Subsystem B: B_Start may remain TRUE through startup.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Fan shall turn on without delay when A_Demand becomes TRUE and A_SafetyTrip is FALSE.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: After A_Demand becomes FALSE, A_Fan shall remain on for 300 ms unless A_SafetyTrip occurs.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_SafetyTrip shall turn A_Fan and A_RunOn off immediately.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_RunOn shall indicate the interval in which A_Demand is FALSE but the off-delay output remains TRUE.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: A permitted B_Start shall enter pre-lube with B_LubePump TRUE and B_MotorCommand FALSE.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_State=0 AND B_Start AND B_Permit AND !B_Stop AND !B_Fault)->X(B_State=1)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_MotorCommand may B_Start only after B_OilPressure remains TRUE for 300 ms.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Failure to receive B_MotorFeedback within 400 ms of B_MotorCommand shall latch B_Fault and enter B_Cooldown.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (feedback_timeout -> (B_Fault AND B_State=4 AND !B_MotorCommand)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_OilPressure loss while running shall immediately B_Stop the motor, latch B_Fault, and enter B_Cooldown.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_State=3 AND !B_OilPressure)->(B_Fault AND !B_MotorCommand AND B_State=4)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Stop or B_Permit loss shall B_Stop B_MotorCommand and enter a 300 ms B_Cooldown with B_LubePump remaining TRUE.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (((B_Stop OR !B_Permit) AND prev(B_State)>0)->(B_State=4 AND !B_MotorCommand)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset clears B_Fault only in idle with B_Start FALSE; B_Cooldown completion returns idle without clearing B_Fault.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_Reset AND B_State=0 AND !B_Start)->!B_Fault))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_Fan shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_LubePump AND NOT B_MotorCommand AND NOT B_Cooldown AND NOT B_Fault AND B_State=0)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_LubePump AND NOT B_MotorCommand AND NOT B_Cooldown AND NOT B_Fault AND B_State=0))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
